provenance.paper_title: Global Prior Meets Local Consistency: Dual-Memory Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model for Efficient Robotic Manipulation

representation_paths.memory_component: trajectory priors and recurrent action state

evidence.paraphrase: Global Prior Memory retrieves trajectories and Local Consistency Memory tracks executed actions.
A fixed Mamba module updates action-consistency state. For OptimusVLA, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of trajectory priors and recurrent action state.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (trajectory priors and recurrent action state) changes through a trained but frozen update module; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
